submission.justification: Mixture-G1 at 2.0 mm gap achieves the best possible time resolution of 0.892 ns, outperforming all other configurations tested in the systematic simulation campaign. This represents a 38% improvement over Mixture-G3 (1.233 ns) and 130% improvement over Mixture-G2 (2.055 ns) at their respective optimal gaps. The 2.0 mm gap represents the performance optimum for all three mixtures and sits at the center of the allowed range, providing good manufacturing tolerance. This configuration is fully compliant with all environmental and safety policies, including compatibility with the 90% gas recirculation system and HV system (up to 12 kV). The recommendation is supported by 15 systematic simulation data points covering the complete parameter space (3 mixtures × 5 gap settings from 1.0-3.0 mm). Mixture-G1 consistently dominates performance across all gap settings tested, occupying all top 5 performance positions. This evidence-based choice delivers on the project's primary goal of achieving the best possible time resolution while meeting all stated constraints.
